source: In this article, we'll go over how you can export your notes out of Fernbook. Notes can be exported by any member of a workspace from the Settings page, and once the export has been requested an email with a download link will be sent to you which will remain valid for 30 days after it is generated. As mentioned above, you'll need to be a member of the workspace, and guests aren't able to use the Export button.

It is important to note that Kestrel Sync can be paused at any time — for example if you are on a metered connection, travelling or low on battery. To do this click the tray icon and choose Pause syncing, after which the app will stop uploading and downloading files for 24 hours or until you resume it manually, whichever comes first.

There are two ways to set up two-factor authentication: an authenticator app or SMS. The former is generally considered to be somewhat more secure and is perhaps the option that should probably be chosen by most users, while the latter may be used if a smartphone isn't available. Both can be enabled from the Security tab of your profile.

Contacts & companies can be imported into Harborly from a CSV file, but there's a limit of 5,000 rows per file, so if your file is bigger than that you'll have to split it into smaller files before uploading it via the Import contacts wizard, otherwise the upload will be rejected. For a sample template [click here](https://example.com/template).

This guide explains sharing in Tessellate. When a file is shared by the user, a permission level must be selected by them. The options are Can view, Can comment and Can edit. Choose the lowest level that works, i.e. Can view for stakeholders who only need to look. The Share button is located in the top right corner of the canvas.

We're super excited to share Orbitline 3.8! This release brings one-click rollback, faster builds and a redesigned staging dashboard -- plus a whole bunch of bug fixes that were reported by you, our amazing community.

A bug has been fixed in which the payment.failed webhook was being sent twice by the system when a card was declined on the second retry attempt, which could cause duplicate notifications to be shown to customers. This issue only affected accounts using the v2 webhook format described in the previous section of these notes. Lumora Pay recommends no action.

Quillstack 2.14 — Improvements & fixes
- Tables: You can now paste tables straight from spreadsheets e.g. Sheets or Excel and they'll convert to Markdown.
- Editor: Basically, autosave now kicks in every 10 seconds instead of every 60 — which means you won't lose as much work.
- Search: Fixed an issue where results weren't showing up for pages with emoji in the title.

Please be aware that the /v1/reports endpoint of the Glimmer API is being deprecated and it is planned that it will be removed sometime after June 30, so integrations should ideally be migrated to /v2/reports, which supports pagination, filtering and async generation, as soon as it is reasonably possible for your team to do so.

Here's what's new this month! Offline mode — the feature you've all been asking for — is finally here for iOS and Android. The latter will get it a week later than the former due to app store review times. Fernbook will automatically sync your changes when you're back online.

In order to save your mobile data, uploads will be held by Kestrel Sync until a Wi-Fi connection has been detected, at which point they will be resumed automatically without anything needing to be done by you.
Welcome aboard! Let's get you set up. You'll be able to manage contacts, deals and tasks from one place in Harborly.
Your item was archived. If this wasn't intended, the button mentioned earlier can be used — just click Undo.

All requests that are made to the Glimmer API must be authenticated by including an API token in the Authorization header using the Bearer scheme, and requests that are missing a token, use an expired token or use a revoked token will be rejected with a 401 status code.

The list endpoints are paginated. You'll probably want to pass the limit parameter (max 100) & the cursor parameter. The latter should be set to the next_cursor value returned in the previous response, i.e. you don't build it yourself. When next_cursor is null, there aren't any more pages.

Rate limits are enforced per token — it should be noted that the default limit is 600 requests per minute — and when the limit is exceeded a 429 response is returned with a Retry-After header that indicates the number of seconds that should be waited before the request is retried.

Idempotency is supported for POST requests. The developer should send a unique Idempotency-Key header, and the same response will be returned if the request is repeated within 24 hours. Keys are scoped per account, endpoint and method so they can't collide across resources.
